[{"word":"imposing","pronun":"[ɪmˈpoʊzɪŋ]","translation":"v. impose的ing形式
adj. （建筑物等）壮观的；威风的；（仪表）堂堂的；给人深刻印象的","audio":"imposing.mp3"},{"word":"inaccessible","pronun":"[ˌɪnækˈsesəbl]","translation":"adj. 难达到的；难接近的；难见到的","audio":"inaccessible.mp3"},{"word":"incompatible","pronun":"[ˌɪnkəmˈpætəbl]","translation":"n. 互不相容的人或事物
adj. 不相容的；矛盾的；不能同时成立的","audio":"incompatible.mp3"},{"word":"incredibly","pronun":"[ɪnˈkredəbli]","translation":"adv. 难以置信地；非常地","audio":"incredibly.mp3"},{"word":"indefinitely","pronun":"[ɪnˈdefɪnətli]","translation":"adv. 不确定地，无限期地；模糊地，不明确地","audio":"indefinitely.mp3"},{"word":"inevitably","pronun":"[ɪnˈevɪtəbli]","translation":"adv. 不可避免地；必然地","audio":"inevitably.mp3"},{"word":"infection","pronun":"[ɪnˈfekʃn]","translation":"n. 感染；传染；影响；传染病","audio":"infection.mp3"},{"word":"infinitely","pronun":"[ˈɪnfɪnətli]","translation":"adv. 无限地；极其","audio":"infinitely.mp3"},{"word":"informed","pronun":"[ɪnˈfɔːrmd]","translation":"v. 通知；使了解；提供资料（inform的过去分词）
adj. 消息灵通的；见多识广的","audio":"informed.mp3"},{"word":"infusion","pronun":"[ɪnˈfjuːʒn]","translation":"n. 灌输；浸泡；注入物；激励","audio":"infusion.mp3"},{"word":"initially","pronun":"[ɪˈnɪʃəli]","translation":"adv. 最初，首先；开头","audio":"initially.mp3"},{"word":"innate","pronun":"[ɪˈneɪt]","translation":"adj. 先天的；固有的；与生俱来的","audio":"innate.mp3"},{"word":"innovative","pronun":"[ˈɪnəveɪtɪv]","translation":"adj. 革新的，创新的；新颖的；有创新精神的","audio":"innovative.mp3"},{"word":"insanity","pronun":"[ɪnˈsænəti]","translation":"n. 疯狂；精神错乱；精神病；愚顽","audio":"insanity.mp3"},{"word":"inspection","pronun":"[ɪnˈspekʃn]","translation":"n. 视察，检查","audio":"inspection.mp3"},{"word":"inspirational","pronun":"[ˌɪnspəˈreɪʃənl]","translation":"adj. 鼓舞人心的；带有灵感的，给予灵感的","audio":"inspirational.mp3"},{"word":"inspiring","pronun":"[ɪnˈspaɪərɪŋ]","translation":"v. 鼓舞；激发；使感悟（inspire的ing形式）
adj. 鼓舞人心的；灌输的；启发灵感的","audio":"inspiring.mp3"},{"word":"instability","pronun":"[ˌɪnstəˈbɪləti]","translation":"n. 不稳定（性）；基础薄弱；不安定","audio":"instability.mp3"},{"word":"instructive","pronun":"[ɪnˈstrʌktɪv]","translation":"adj. 有益的；教育性的","audio":"instructive.mp3"},{"word":"intake","pronun":"[ˈɪnteɪk]","translation":"n. 摄取量；通风口；引入口；引入的量","audio":"intake.mp3"}]
